title: The Missing Apprentice
description: Perrin took himself south to the cultists in the ruin - they did not take him. He went because I would not teach him the working he wanted. What I fear is that the working is real.

objectives.description: Find the temple south of Thornfield

notes: Rescue kind 3 of 4: the captors were not the danger. Perrin went to the cultists willingly, seeking a working his own master refused to teach him; the cultists are running the ritual he asked for, not holding him prisoner. Giver motive: the wizard is implicated in why Perrin left, and cannot say that part aloud. Consequence of refusal: the working completes on its own timeline regardless of who is or isn't present to stop it.
